d: Located at the heart of Place Vendôme, Maison Chaumet has been an emblem of Parisian jewellery excellence since 1780. With exceptional savoir-faire passed down through generations, Chaumet’s history is deeply intertwined with French history and the legacy of Empress Joséphine. Today, as part of the LVMH Group, the Maison continues its transformation and global repositioning, supported by strong business growth.
Chaumet Middle East is looking for a Sales or Senior Sales Advisor in Qatar.
r: In this dynamic and challenging growth context, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of Chaumet. You will represent the Maison by:
1/ Being Ambassador of the Maison to all our clients
Share the passion of more than 240 years of history, with a culture of excellence and knowledge;
Make the Chaumet Experience alive by a warm and luxurious welcoming;
Offer a relevant selection of pieces and assist the client in his purchasing process;
Play a key role in the selling ceremony knowing how to surprise the client;
Take clients on an emotional journey and drive them through the discovery of the world of Chaumet.
2/ Contributing to the boutique’s commercial development by finding new clients and retaining existing ones
Achieve your sales objectives to make sure the boutique and your colleagues achieve theirs;
Actively participate in the development of the customer database by consulting, creating and updating customer files;
Create new future opportunities after concluding sales by developing your own customer portfolio and enlarging our reachable client base;
Carry out clienteling activities by inviting our clients and prospects to events organized by the Maison;
Anticipate VIP Clients visit by preparing the right selection depending on the occasion.
3/ Participating to flawless store operations and being an active part of the store’s life
Contribute to achieve the boutique’s collective targets by working with your colleagues;
Actively participate in team meetings, challenges, events and activities, giving your contribution;
Participate in the reporting and monitoring of performance indicators and customer feedback;
Ensure the application of security guidelines, cashier registration procedures and stock management rules;
Contribute to reporting and analysis as requested by the HQ, be a point of reference for Client’s feedback;
Visual Merchandising: work on windows and internal display in collaboration with the Visual Merchandising team;

d: BEAMS is one of Japan’s leading culture shops, bringing together fashion, lifestyle, food and art.
BEAMS Abu Dhabi creates a cultural bridge between Japan and Abu Dhabi, connecting people and ideas to shape new culture together.

At BEAMS, we create memorable experiences through creativity, craftsmanship, thoughtful service and genuine hospitality. Guided by the Japanese philosophy of Omotenashi, we anticipate customer needs, pay attention to every detail and make every visit personal and inspiring.
We are looking for a Sales Executive to join our team in Abu Dhabi and create a thoughtful, personalised retail experience for every customer.

As a Sales Executive, you will create a welcoming customer experience by helping customers discover products, styling ideas and stories that suit their needs and lifestyle, while managing the complete customer journey from greeting and personalised recommendations to styling, mobile POS checkout, careful packaging and farewell. You will develop broad product knowledge across the store while building expertise in selected categories; experience in women’s fashion, beauty or cosmetics retail is an advantage.
Welcome customers naturally while respecting personal space and culture
Understand customer needs before recommending products or styling ideas
Explain product specifications, curation stories and lifestyle fit
Provide fitting-room support while protecting customer privacy
Complete cash and card sales accurately using approved POS access
Confirm items, package purchases carefully and provide a sincere farewell
Maintain approved VMD, sales-floor, fitting-room and product-care standards
Coordinate replenishment and stock enquiries with the Receiving Clerk
Collect customer details only with consent and through approved systems
Refer returns, discounts, refunds and compensation requests to the manager for approval
Accurately process sales while protecting products, payment devices and customer information
2+ years of experience in fashion, lifestyle or premium retail preferred
Experience in consultative or styling-led sales preferred
Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage
Strong customer listening and styling skills
Ability to communicate product stories in an engaging way
Strong digital POS and transaction accuracy
Cultural sensitivity and a collaborative approach
Genuine passion for customer experience, fashion, lifestyle and culture
Participation in events, launches and stock counts
If you are passionate about fashion, culture, lifestyle and exceptional customer experiences, we would love to hear from you.
Join BEAMS Abu Dhabi and be part of a team connecting Japanese creativity, culture and hospitality with Abu Dhabi.
